    - `gh api repos/meadow/events/pulls/642/comments --paginate` and `gh api repos/meadow/events/issues/642/comments --paginate`: empty, so there is no delta and no reviewer workflow is known.
11. **Merge preconditions all hold.** Per Next action, the run renders a fresh final menu and never auto-merges.
